item.title: Why New York State taxes fund healthcare and benefits for undocumented immigrants
item.description: New York State provides several social safety net benefits to undocumented immigrants, including healthcare, food, and education, as required by the state constitution, while federal law prohibits the use of federal funds for these benefits.
